evidence_level: revealed development cross-validation conditional on an oracle ROI
objective: Test whether cheap ROI-local texture and request geometry can predict the preferred 384/512 encoding scale once an upstream region proposal is available.
features: ROI crop width, height, aspect ratio and pixel count
ROI request position and area fraction
64x64 ROI RGB, luminance, histogram, gradient, edge and pooled-grid statistics

model.type: ridge regression on continuous utility gain

gate.noninferiority_rule: paired 95% bootstrap lower bound must be at or above the margin

mandatory_boundary: The current crop is generated from ground truth. Passing only supports a scale controller conditional on a correct ROI; it does not validate region localization.
